payload.name: Local First Then Sync to the EU
payload.description: Source edits happen on the local tree. The EU host is synced from local and built there only when needed. Before any EU deploy the two are diffed so nothing that exists only on the EU is lost.

principles.name: One source of truth
principles.description: Editing the EU first leaves local outdated and drops work later.

heuristics.condition: the EU has pipelines built that local lacks
heuristics.action: expect this and reconcile through the diff, not by dropping them
back up the running binary under a timestamped name first and record the rollback

decision_rules.name: Edit local first
decision_rules.outcome: make it in the local tree; never edit the EU first, even while the EU is under test

decision_rules.name: Diff before deploy
decision_rules.condition: a deploy to the EU is about to start
decision_rules.outcome: diff the EU tree against local by hash, and bring anything present or newer only on the EU into local first

decision_rules.name: Never overwrite blindly
decision_rules.outcome: do not copy EU over local without a reviewed diff; list EU-only files without deleting them

decision_rules.name: Ship paired parts together
decision_rules.condition: a host binary or tool changes
decision_rules.outcome: deploy it together with the shared files it depends on (for example tools/shared/guard.mjs)

decision_rules.name: Keep data changes reversible
decision_rules.condition: data on the EU is changed
decision_rules.outcome: save before-copies under docs/evidence and note how to restore them, and change nothing the operator did not allow
